pairs.question: Why is it so hard to quit smoking?
pairs.answer: The chemical addiction to nicotine and the habits formed around smoking make it hard to quit. Each time you use tobacco, nicotine triggers the brain's reward system, leading to addiction.
pairs.evidence: The chemical addiction and the habits people form around smoking, when combined, make it hard to quit.
